title: Measure Department Ruling: Remeasure Cost Sharing on Customer Remakes — Factory Production Orders
content:
**Ruling.** For Factory Production Orders, a measurement share applies to the charge for a customer specification remake by the completed measure visits on the window contract the order builds:

| Completed measure visits on that contract | Share of the charge due |
|---|---|
| a company remeasure was completed | 50 percent — Ridgeline carries half |
| no company remeasure, but a customer-requested remeasure was completed | 80 percent |
| neither | the full charge |

The share multiplies the charge base itself, and the charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Records read

The measure visits on the Window Replacement Contracts record of the contract, by visit kind and outcome: a company remeasure is one ordered by Ridgeline; a customer-requested remeasure is the remeasure visit kind. Only visits whose outcome is completed count; a no-show, a late reschedule or a company-rescheduled visit does not. The final measure is neither kind.

## Combinations

| Company remeasure completed | Customer-requested remeasure completed | Share due |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 50 percent |
| yes | no | 50 percent |
| no | yes | 80 percent |
| no | no | full |

## Hypothetical case

A contract with a completed customer-requested remeasure and a company remeasure that ended in a customer no-show: 80 percent is due, because the company remeasure was not completed.
